Pose Landmarker Lite and Hand Landmarker model bundles (float16 version 1)
Source: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-models/
MediaPipe Models are distributed under Apache License 2.0.

The runtime vision.js is the unmodified npm vision_bundle.cjs file, renamed
to .js for a standard browser JavaScript MIME type. WASM binaries and model
bundles are unmodified. Patient images, videos and measurements are not
included in this distribution.
